# scripts

Helpers for the render-and-verify loop. Run them with `bash` (installs do not keep the executable bit), using the absolute path of this skill directory when working from a project.

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| `contact-sheet.sh <out.png> <frame.png>...` | Tiles frames side by side (start, mid, end) into one image for review. Frames must share the same height. |
| `probe-mp4.sh <file.mp4> [WxH] [fps]` | Prints resolution, codec, fps and duration of the encoded file; with `WxH`/`fps` it exits non-zero on a mismatch and warns when the codec is not h264. |

Both need `ffmpeg` and `ffprobe` on PATH and a Bash shell (macOS, Linux, or WSL/Git Bash on Windows).

## Remotion

```bash
npx remotion still Promo out/f-start.png --frame=0  --props='{...}'
npx remotion still Promo out/f-mid.png   --frame=75 --props='{...}'
npx remotion still Promo out/f-end.png   --frame=149 --props='{...}'
bash scripts/contact-sheet.sh out/sheet.png out/f-start.png out/f-mid.png out/f-end.png
npx remotion render Promo out/promo.mp4 --props='{...}'
bash scripts/probe-mp4.sh out/promo.mp4 1080x1920 30
```
